# Code Anchors: Initiative

- `components/commands/nxs.epic.md` — proposes the objective, the order and the reach statements at the consent choice, files the initiative before its stubs, writes the stub numbers into its order, and reads its children back.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/keys.ts` — declares the initiative label, defaulting to `initiative`, and the initiative issue type, which has no default.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/issue-kind.ts` — the kind rule that reads an issue as an initiative, testing that marker after every other kind.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/story-filer/stub-parent.ts` — allows an initiative as a stub's parent and refuses every other parent.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/story-filer/initiative.spec.ts` — coverage for filing the initiative as its own batch and its stubs as its children.
- `libs/epic-resolve/src/resolve.ts` — the resolver's refusal of an initiative, by name.
- `libs/epic-resolve/src/diagnostic.ts` — the `is-an-initiative` problem the resolver reports.
- `libs/epic-verdicts/src/close-command.ts` — close's refusal of an initiative it is pointed at.
- `libs/pr-worktree/src/story-candidates.ts` — never walks up from an epic to the initiative above it.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/epic-initiative.spec.ts` — coverage for the gate, the declined flat filing, the filing order and the run folder's lifetime.
- `components/skills/nxs-epic-resolve/SKILL.md` — names the initiative refusal among the resolver's diagnostics.
- `components/commands/nxs.intake.md` — files its follow-ups flat, since only a decomposition in the epic stage files under an initiative.
